summary.text: Nicole Ventour is the Democratic candidate for South Carolina House of Representatives District 45 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Brandon Newton.
A licensed clinical social worker, she ran for the same seat in 2024, receiving 35.5% of the vote.

paragraphs.text: Nicole Ventour was born in Brooklyn, New York, and earned a bachelor's degree from Medgar Evers College in 2002 and a graduate degree from Yeshiva University in 2007.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as licensed clinical social worker and community advocate, and notes affiliation with the National Association of Social Workers.

In her 2026 survey, Ventour said she moved to Lancaster, South Carolina, 13 years earlier and opened a mental health agency, The Right Direction, LLC, where she worked as a psychotherapist and offered free after-school care for children receiving behavioral health services.
Ventour was the Democratic nominee for District 45 in 2024, when Newton defeated her 64.3% to 35.5% in the general election.
In her survey, she named mental health reform, gun safety, women's rights and infrastructure improvement as the policy areas she is most passionate about.
